components.name: security-audit-skill
notes: Source of the phase model, the coverage ledger, report-schema.json and the two validators.
The validators reject every input on native Windows (O_NOFOLLOW and O_NONBLOCK are undefined). kalkan ports them to Python.

components.name: sast-skills
notes: The upstream skills live in sast-files/.claude/skills. They are copied to skills/ so that Claude Code does not load them.
The upstream orchestration file sast-files/CLAUDE.md is renamed so that no agent host loads it.

components.name: codecrucible

components.name: gitlab-sast-rules
components.license: MIT and LGPL-3.0-only (the license header of each file)
notes: Opengrep rule pack (ADR-0005, K.8). Copied: the rule files of csharp, java, javascript, python and scala (license header 'MIT (c) GitLab Inc.') and of rules/lgpl (license header 'GNU Lesser General Public License v3.0'; rules/lgpl/LICENSE is the LGPL-3.0 text). The test sources next to the rules are not copied (some carry the LGPL-3.0 header of find-sec-bugs).

Not copied: rules/lgpl-cc (LGPL-2.1 with the Commons Clause, which forbids selling services that derive their value from the rules), rules/gitlab (GitLab Enterprise Edition license, not open source), c (GPL-2.0 port of flawfinder, which kalkan runs itself), go (Apache-2.0 port of gosec, which kalkan runs itself), mappings, qa, ci and spec.

ADR-0005 and the 2026-10-19 research name the license 'LGPL-2.1'. The files say LGPL-3.0. The LGPL-3.0 adds permissions to the GPL-3.0, whose text is not in the upstream repository: https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt
kalkan runs the kept rules from rules/opengrep-packs/gitlab (scripts/build_opengrep_packs.py, docs/ENGINE-SPEC.md section 13).

components.name: 0xdea-semgrep-rules
notes: Opengrep rule pack for C and C++ (ADR-0005, K.8). The C and C++ test sources next to the rules are not copied.
kalkan runs the kept rules from rules/opengrep-packs/0xdea (scripts/build_opengrep_packs.py).

components.name: trailofbits-semgrep-rules
notes: Opengrep rule pack (ADR-0005, K.8; license policy of 2026-10-25: AGPL-3.0 rule files stay unmodified in their own folder with the license text, and kalkan is not offered as a network service). The test files next to the rules are not copied.
The pack belongs to the restricted group: KALKAN_RULE_PACKS=osi turns it off (docs/ENGINE-SPEC.md section 13).
kalkan runs the kept rules from rules/opengrep-packs/trailofbits (scripts/build_opengrep_packs.py).
